organiser.name: Go Skateboarding Day Perú organisers (promoter Abraham Montoya named in press)

add_sources.note: El Comercio: the 2026 edition 'cuenta con el apoyo de Vans, EPIDEMICK, OLLIE SKATE, GRAVITAL y TRIBU SKATE, entre otras organizaciones'.
Abraham Montoya described as 'uno de los impulsores del evento'; no organising body named; event held in Peru for more than 13 years.

Programme: urban skate ride from Plaza San Martín to Playa Redondo II (Miraflores), Best Trick contest, raffles and prizes, live art, yoga sessions, a masterclass, cultural fair, food areas and 12+ punk and rock bands.
